profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory

positions.title: Bioinformatics Software Engineer / Project Manager
positions.description:
Lead developer for Web Apollo, a web based annotation editor, which provides real time functionality, through the use of AJAX/Comet, that facilitates distributed community annotation efforts.  Lead developer and project manager for Apollo, a Java-based cross-platform
desktop annotation editor.

positions.title: Bioinformatics Engineer
positions.description: Designed tools and algorithms for data analysis in a Linux environment, mostly implemented in C/C++ and Perl. Worked closely with Bioinformatics Analysts and Principal Investigators to provide the analysis needed. Some of these include single nucleotide polymorphism identification, phylogenetic analysis, and pathway identification. Also developed tools for streamlining submissions to the Genbank repository.

positions.title: Java Instructor
positions.description: Taught classes covering Java, concentrating on J2SE.  Responsible for class planning and lecturing.  The track consisted of 3 different levels: beginner (covers the very basic of Java), intermediate (covers more of the API, such as the Collections Framework, and more complex concepts such as OOP design), and advanced (covers the more advanced API, such as XML, JDBC, I/O handling).

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: Maintaining and managing National Center for Biotechnology Information's (NCBI) HomoloGene project as the lead software engineer.   This project required a software suite to help determine genetic similarities amongst different organisms and to help deduce sequence information for organisms where this data is unavailable.  Computational software used advanced algorithms to optimize memory usage and speed, due to the very large amounts of data.  Distributed algorithms were used to take advantage of large computer cluster available, taking advantage of fifty processors concurrently to optimize very large computations.  Also was responsible for developing schema and writing software for populating and maintaining databases used by this and other projects, which are used to provide information to users outside of NCBI.
